title: Insects: the food of the future?
text: By 2050 there will be almost ten billion people on Earth. Feeding all of them will be one of the biggest challenges of this century. Many scientists think that insects will be part of the solution.

For about two billion people, mostly in Asia, Africa and Latin America, eating insects is already normal. There are more than two thousand edible species, from crickets and ants to beetles and caterpillars.
Insects have several advantages. They have a lot of protein, vitamins and healthy fats. They need much less water, land and food than cows or pigs. They also produce fewer gases that warm the planet.

However, in Europe and North America many people feel disgust when they think about eating a bug. That is why companies are trying new ideas. They grind crickets into flour and use it in pasta, bread and protein bars. You will not see the insect at all.

Will we all eat insects in the future? Nobody knows for sure. But experts predict that the market will grow very quickly. Maybe one day your favorite snack will be made of crickets, and you will not even notice!

grammar.title: Grammar: will for predictions
grammar.rule: Use will + verb to make predictions about the future. The negative is will not. Use Will...? for questions.
items: By 2050 there ___ be ten billion people.
Insects ___ be part of the solution.

es.title: Los insectos, ¿comida del futuro?
es.grammar: Gramática: will para predicciones sobre el futuro: will + verbo. Negativo: will not. Pregunta: Will...?
